components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Working action on light app screens. Electric blue, lifts on hover, presses on active.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2f6df6; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; padding: 13px 18px; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(11,31,58,0.10); transition: background 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease, filter 0.16s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #1e4fd0; transform: translateY(-1px); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Red Button
components.description: Destructive/negative action. Competition red identity accent, used sparingly.
components.css: .ds-btn-red { background: #ef3e4a; color: #fff; border: 1px solid #ef3e4a; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; padding: 13px 18px; transition: background 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease, transform 0.16s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-red:hover, .ds-btn-red:focus-visible { background: #c92f3a; border-color: #c92f3a; outline: none; } .ds-btn-red:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: White Button
components.description: Quiet secondary. White fill, blue text, hairline border; inverts to blue fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-white { background: #fff; color: #2f6df6; border: 1px solid #e3e8f0; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 600; padding: 13px 18px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(11,31,58,0.08); transition: background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-white:hover, .ds-btn-white:focus-visible { background: #2f6df6; color: #fff; border-color: #2f6df6; outline: none; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field. Hairline border, blue focus glow ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #fff; color: #1b2430; border: 1px solid #e3e8f0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 13px 14px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; transition: border-color 0.16s ease, box-shadow 0.16s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7787; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #2f6df6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47,109,246,0.18); }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Light-screen results/list table. Pale header band, uppercase muted labels, soft row hover, clipped rounded corners on ambient shadow.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; background: #fff; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(11,31,58,0.10); border-collapse: collapse; color: #1b2430; } .ds-table thead th { background: #f7f9fc; color: #6b7787; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 14px 16px; text-align: left; border-bottom: 2px solid #e3e8f0; } .ds-table tbody td { padding: 13px 16px; font-weight: 500; border-top: 1px solid #e3e8f0; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #f5f8ff; }

components.name: Current Label
components.description: The gold 'current' marker — reserved for the live athlete/element. Rarity is the meaning.
components.css: .ds-label-current { display: inline-block; background: #f5b53d; color: #0b1f3a; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(245,181,61,0.35); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Fixed navy sidebar link; brightens with a gold left-edge marker on hover.
components.html: ТаблоСудейство
components.css: .ds-side-nav { background: #0b1f3a; width: 232px; padding: 16px 0; } .ds-side-link { display: block; padding: 14px 22px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.82); font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; border-left: 3px solid transparent; transition: background 0.16s ease, color 0.16s ease, border-color 0.16s ease; } .ds-side-link:hover, .ds-side-link.ds-active { color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-left-color: #f5b53d; }

narrative.overview: The visual language of an official sports federation running a live competition — structured, ceremonial, and trustworthy under pressure, without ever raising its voice. A deep navy shell frames every screen like the border of a crest; electric blue does the working; competition red marks identity and consequence; a single gold accent is reserved for what is current. An instrument of record first, an interface second. It runs on a LAN of weak clients and a hall projector, so the aesthetic is economical: soft navy-tinted shadows for depth, no glass, no decorative gradients. Two registers live in one system — a calm light workbench for judges and organizers, and immersive dark stage/monitor screens where the moment earns the drama.
keyCharacteristics: Navy-framed shell with a red identity block and a single gold 'current' accent
Two registers in one system: calm light workbench, immersive dark stage/monitor
Soft ambient shadows for structure; no glass, no decorative gradients
Tactile, confident controls sized for fast, mistake-proof judge entry
Light enough to stay fast on weak LAN clients and old browsers

rules.name: The Gold-Means-Now Rule
rules.body: Gold (#f5b53d) is forbidden as decoration. It appears only to mark what is current — the live athlete, active element, main mark. If gold is on screen in more than one meaning, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Cool-Ground Rule
rules.body: The light background is cool (#eef2f8), never a warm cream or beige. Warmth is not this brand; officialdom is.

rules.name: The Navy-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted navy (rgba(11,31,58,…)), never neutral gray/black. A gray shadow reads as generic Bootstrap; the navy tint keeps depth on-brand.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Inter is the only typeface. Hierarchy is weight (500→800) and size. A second family would read as marketing, which this is not.

dos: Do reserve gold (#f5b53d) exclusively for current — the live athlete, active element, main mark.
Do keep the light background cool (#eef2f8); this brand carries no warmth.
Do tint shadows navy (rgba(11,31,58,…)) so depth stays on-brand.
Do build hierarchy from Inter weights (500→800) and size alone.
Do size the judging controls large and give clear press/hover feedback — the hot path must be fast and mistake-proof.
Do push the stage/monitor screens beyond AA contrast for hall-distance legibility, with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
Do keep runtime light — effects and JS must stay cheap for weak LAN clients and old browsers.
donts: Don't make it look like consumer SaaS or a startup dashboard — no playful gradients, mascots, or marketing flourish.
Don't fall back to generic gray Bootstrap-admin — the flat gray-box default this system is being redesigned away from.
Don't build a cluttered broadcast scoreboard — no competing overlays or animations fighting for attention.
Don't drift to enterprise gray — no tiny gray text at ERP density; body text is 500-weight ink.
Don't introduce a second typeface or a decorative display face; Inter is the only family.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards or list items (the 3px gold sidebar marker on nav items is the one sanctioned exception).
Don't use decorative glassmorphism or gradient text anywhere.
